criteria: The sense set covers the common A1 uses appropriate to the UID and part of speech.
Every example expresses its assigned sense in a normal, concrete context.
French, English, Spanish and Chinese sentences have aligned meaning.
No generic discussion or vocabulary-lesson filler sentence is accepted.
